name: Top bar
fit: A horizontal bar and a stacked page.
layout: A horizontal bar instead of a sidebar. The page stacks underneath. Cases sit in a wrapping row of cards.
typography: Editorial. Titles are larger, body line height is looser, captions stay small.
fonts: Newsreader for titles. Source Sans 3 for body and captions. Inconsolata for code, token names, and file paths.
icons: Lucide. panels-top-left marks the bar, book-open the brief, palette the design system, layers a feature.
nav: Brief, Design system, and features are items in the bar. The current item is marked.
frames: Cases sit in a wrapping row under the writing. Light and dark sit side by side inside a case card.
chrome: Neutral light and dark for the docs chrome, separate from the product themes inside the frames.
adapt: Keep the horizontal bar and the loose body line height. Keep the chrome neutral so it does not compete with the product. Pair with a font-pairings pick; recommend the pairing that lists this template.
